lines.text: Paul grieves deeply and could wish himself cursed and cut off from Christ for his brothers, the people of Israel.
God's word has not failed, because Abraham's offspring are reckoned through Ishmael, and the promise said Sarah would have a son.
Before Rebecca's twins were born or had done anything, she was told the older will serve the younger.
God tells Moses He will have mercy on whom He has mercy, and He says He raised up Pharaoh to display His wisdom.
Isaiah says only the remnant of Israel will be saved, and without descendants they would have become like Sodom and Gomorrah.
